observed: all four episodes (two tasks x two conditions) chose unverified/recheck after reading M and R1; treatment had no opportunity effect
cause: treatment identified R1 but did not allocate a verification slot to it, so the model spent the same two slots as control and could not reach R3
fix: total budget remains two; treatment prefetches R1 as the first computed slot and gives the model one remaining record read; control retains two discretionary reads
scientific_basis: matches the same-budget critical-slot reallocation intervention read in arXiv 2608.25553; the target is computed rather than supplied by an experimenter
retained: v2 smoke preserved and excluded from effect estimate
